Inexact line search satisfying the strong Wolfe conditions

Source: R/scipy_optimize.R
scipy_optimize_line_search.Rd

Port of jax._src.scipy.optimize.line_search.line_search (algorithm 3.5 of Nocedal and Wright, Numerical Optimization), the line search used by scipy_optimize_minimize(). It is not part of the public jax.scipy.optimize namespace.

Usage

scipy_optimize_line_search(
  f,
  xk,
  pk,
  old_fval = NULL,
  old_old_fval = NULL,
  gfk = NULL,
  c1 = 1e-04,
  c2 = 0.9,
  maxiter = 20L
)

Arguments

f

Function of x returning a scalar.

xk

Starting point.

pk

Search direction.

old_fval, gfk

Value and gradient of f at xk (computed if NULL).

old_old_fval

Value of f at the previous point, used for the initial step.

c1, c2

Constants of the Wolfe conditions.

maxiter

Maximum number of iterations.

Value

A named list with failed, nit, nfev, ngev, k, a_k (the step), f_k, g_k (value and gradient at the new point) and status (0: converged, 1: the zoom failed, 3: maxiter reached).
